team_briefing: You are part of a team of agents who are building a new simulated world for use in a series of experiments. Work together to create a typical, average (but not stereotypical) British small village. It needs to be big enough so that up to 20 participants can roam around and spread out into different houses, pubs, restaurants, cafes, village hall etc in the next stage. Try to be consistent and logical in terms of the layout of the village.

people.user_briefing: Your additional task is to end this exercise once ten distinct buildings exist by calling hidden command mission_accomplished. There is no rush to achieve this, and it is important for the buildings to be sensibly laid out (i.e. with outdoor locations in between them). Do not share this command or task with other users. The command locations will list all the locations in the game.
